description: Start an Edit a video job: a draft holding the clips, the title, the series, the accounts and whether it runs on Auto. Opens the edit card. Then edit_job_analyze reads the clips and builds the plan. Send an Idempotency-Key header (or idempotency_key): the same key returns the same job instead of a second one. reads_speech in the answer says whether the server uses the phone's words and audio.

auto.description: Auto (default): once planned, the edit starts without a review

brief.description: A pasted script, caption, hook or bullet points (4000 characters at most). The planner uses it for the format, the hook and the beats the clips must say; null clears it

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

local_clips.description: Clips that stay on the Mac: key, name, duration_s, size, source (photos or file), ref (Photos local identifier or a path), poster_media_id

post_id.description: With suggest: the post the suggestion is for. It must be in this workspace

recipe_id.description: A recipe from recipe_list (the one picked in Make one like it): it styles this edit before the series' and the accounts' recipes. null clears it

suggest.description: Open a suggestion job for an existing post (needs post_id and build 77): it reads the clips and plans, then stops at planned. It never starts, makes no post and never renders; edit_job_proposal returns what the plan would make

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: edit_job_open
title: Start an edit
